rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Technology marks describe studio capability, not clients or project stacks. Publish supplied facts and verified real screenshot work; do not invent outcomes.

rules.name: The Latest Owner Direction Rule
rules.body: The huge final footer and alternating curved contact corners are intentional and supersede earlier compact-footer and generic-radius defaults.

dos: Do retain pinned proportions, Poppins, waves and navy/white.
Do preserve seven real projects, transparent objects, actual marks, colorful emblem, curved contacts and final huge signature.
Do retain CMS control, visible focus and private persistence before explicit WhatsApp handoff.
Do keep narrow/reduced-motion views static and readable.
donts: Do not restore obsolete four-concept, boxed-service, technology-text or compact-footer guidance.
Do not invent project stacks, outcomes, endorsements, staff or contact details.
Do not treat documentation or local review as production certification.
